test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Superintendence, control and conduct of all election to the municipalities is responsibility of the ______
solution:
The correct answer is __**State Election Commission.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **State Election Commission** is responsible for the **superintendence, control, and conduct **of all municipal elections in the state.
 
• This commission is a **constitutional body** that is independent of the** state government **and is responsible for ensuring **free and fair elections.**
 
• The** Governor of the State** does not have any role to play in the **conduct of municipal elections**, as this is the responsibility of the State Election Commission.
 
• The **Election Commission of India** is responsible for **conducting elections to the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha**, and state legislative assemblies, but not for municipal elections.
 
• **The Home Ministry** of the State may have a role in providing** security and maintaining law** and order during the elections, but it is not responsible for the conduct of the elections themselves.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• The **State Election Commission** is a** constitutional body **established under **Article 243K **of the Constitution of India.

 
 
• Its members are appointed by the **Governor of the State**, in consultation with the **State Government **and the** State Election Commission of India.**
 
 
 
• The **Election Commission of India** is a constitutional body established under **Article 324 **of the Constitution of India.
 
 
• Its members are appointed by the** President of India.**
 
 
 
• **The Home Ministry of the State** is responsible for maintaining law and order, ensuring** public safety, and preventing and detecting crimes.**
 
 
• It is headed by the **Home Minister of the State, **who is a member of the State Cabinet.
